items.text: Sad to say, this project has turned out to be mostly low-level findings about factual errors and spelling and grammar mistakes, combined with lots of head-scratching puzzlement about what in the world those readers really want. But the sources of distrust go way deeper.
items.stem: The results of the journalism credibility project turned out to be ______.
choices: quite trustworthy
somewhat contradictory
very illuminating
rather superficial
items.zh: 遗憾的是，这个项目最终得出的大多是些低层次的发现，涉及事实差错、拼写和语法错误，外加大量令人挠头的困惑——搞不清那些读者究竟想要什么。但不信任的根源要深得多。

items.text: When it comes to the slowing economy, Ellen Spero isn't biting her nails just yet.
items.stem: By "Ellen Spero isn't biting her nails just yet" (Line 1, Paragraph 1), the author means_____.
choices: Spero can hardly maintain her business
Spero is too much engaged in her work
Spero has grown out of her bad habit
Spero is not in a desperate situation
items.zh: 说到正在放缓的经济，埃伦·斯佩罗还不至于紧张得直咬指甲。

It has the capability to identify suspicious citations
It hinders the growth of ``international'' journals
It is established to prevent citation manipulation

items.text: I loved the chap from the Thirties research who found that wireless suddenly offered “a lot of variety... things I thought I'd never be interested in… ice hockey, perhaps”.

choices: the research on radio used to be inadequate.
the charm of radio remains in the digital age.
radio listeners could make unexpected gains.
radio shows have changed little over the years.
items.zh: 我喜欢三十年代研究中的那个家伙，他发现无线电突然提供了“很多花样……我以为我永远不会感兴趣的东西……也许是冰球”。

items.text: Now researchers suspect that dreams are part of the mind's emotional thermostat, regulating moods while the brain is "off-line." But not all parts of the brain are equally involved; the limbic system (the "emotional brain") is especially active, while the prefrontal cortex (the center of intellect and reasoning) is relatively quiet.
items.stem: By referring to the limbic system, the author intends to show
choices: its function in our dreams.
the mechanism of REM sleep.
the relation of dreams to emotions.
its difference from the prefrontal cortex.
items.zh: 如今研究者怀疑，梦是大脑情绪调节器的一部分，在大脑"离线"时负责调节情绪。但并非大脑的所有部分都同等参与其中：边缘系统（"情绪脑"）格外活跃，而前额叶皮层（智力与推理的中枢）则相对平静。

items.text: These unilateral developments differ in their specifics, but they are all designed to tax multinationals on income and revenue that countries believe they should have a right to tax, even if international tax rules do not grant them that right. In other words, they all share a view that the international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy.
items.stem: The countries adopting the unilateral measures share the opinion that ______ .
choices: redistribution of tech giants' revenue must be ensured
the current international tax system needs upgrading
tech multinationals' monopoly should be prevented
all countries ought to enjoy equal taxing rights
items.zh: 这些单边举措在具体细节上各不相同，但它们都旨在就各国认为自己有权征税的所得和收入向跨国公司征税，即便国际税收规则并未赋予它们这一权利。换句话说，他们全都持有这样一种观点：国际税收体系未能跟上当前经济的发展。

items.text: The threat of nationalisation may have been seen off for now, but it will return with a vengeance if the justified anger of passengers is not addressed in short order.
items.stem: If unable to calm down passengers, the railways may have to face ______ .
choices: the loss of investment
the collapse of operations
a reduction of revenue
a change of ownership
items.zh: 国有化的威胁或许暂时被化解了，但如果乘客们正当的愤怒不能尽快得到回应，它将以更猛烈之势卷土重来。

items.text: Officials must not be allowed to play favorites in providing information or in arranging meetings simply because an individual or group provides a campaign donation or a personal gift. This type of integrity requires well-enforced laws in government transparency, such as records of official meetings, rules on lobbying, and information about each elected leader's source of wealth.
items.stem: Well-enforced laws in government transparency are needed to ______ .
choices: awaken the conscience of officials
guarantee fair play in official access
allow for certain kinds of lobbying
inspire hopes in average people
items.zh: 决不能仅仅因为某个人或团体提供了竞选捐款或私人礼物，就允许官员在提供信息或安排会面时厚此薄彼。这种廉正需要在政府透明度方面有得到切实执行的法律，例如官方会议记录、游说规则，以及有关每位民选领导人财富来源的信息。

items.text: Immigrants are quickly fitting into this common culture, which may not be altogether elevating but is hardly poisonous. In 1998 immigrants were 9.8 percent of the population; in 1900, 13.6 percent.
items.stem: The text suggests that immigrants now in the U.S.
choices: are resistant to homogenization.
exert a great influence on American culture.
are hardly a threat to the common culture.
constitute the majority of the population.
items.zh: 移民正在迅速融入这种共同文化，这种文化也许并非完全令人向上，但也几乎无害。1998年移民占总人口的9.8%；而1900年则占13.6%。

items.text: Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.
items.stem: Hindrance to the reform of the legal system originates from
choices: the rigid bodies governing the profession.
lawyers’ and clients’ strong resistance.
the stern exam for would-be lawyers.
non-professionals’ sharp criticism.
items.zh: 明智的改革主意早已存在多年，但管理这一行业的州级机构过于保守，以致迟迟不予实施。

items.text: Manuscripts will be flagged up for additional scrutiny by the journal's internal editors, or by its existing Board of Reviewing Editors or by outside peer reviewers. The SBoRE panel will then find external statisticians to review these manuscripts.
items.stem: The phrase “flagged up” (Para. 2) is the closest in meaning to
choices: found.
revised.
marked.
stored.
items.zh: 稿件将由该期刊的内部编辑、或其现有的评审编辑委员会、或外部同行评审人标记出来，以接受额外审查。随后，SBoRE 小组将寻找外部统计学家来审查这些稿件。

items.text: I was shocked to learn recently that some scientists want to scale back their research in an effort to decrease carbon emissions.
items.stem: The author expressed great surprise at some scientists’ .
choices: unwillingness to cut carbon emissions
intention to reduce their research
suspicions about sustainable energy
waste of electricity in their projects
items.zh: 最近我震惊地得知，一些科学家想要缩减他们的研究，以努力减少碳排放。

items.stem: The financial problem with the USPS is caused partly by ______ .
choices: its unbalanced budget
its rigid management
the cost for technical upgrading
the withdrawal of bank support
items.zh: 从根本上说，美国邮政局正处于一种历史性的挤压之中：一边是永久性地降低了对其主打产品（即一类邮件）需求的技术变革，另一边是使管理层无法灵活地根据新现实调整运营的监管结构。

items.text: Researchers admit that their study does not answer the question of how much businesses ought to spend on CSR.
items.stem: Which of the following is true of CSR according to the last paragraph?
choices: Its negative effects on businesses are often overlooked
The necessary amount of companies spending on it is unknown
Companies' financial capacity for it has been overestimated
It has brought much benefit to the banking industry
items.zh: 研究者们承认，他们的研究并未回答企业究竟应该在CSR上花费多少这一问题。

items.text: For the most part, the response has been favorable, to say the least. One of the reasons why the appointment came as such a surprise, however, is that Gilbert is comparatively little known.
items.stem: We learn from Paragraph 1 that Gilbert’s appointment has
choices: incurred criticism.
raised suspicion.
received acclaim.
aroused curiosity.
items.zh: 在很大程度上，至少可以说，反响一直是积极的。然而，这一任命之所以如此令人意外，原因之一便是吉尔伯特相对而言鲜为人知。

items.text: Board members like her “casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists as just another misguided opinion,” says Dan Quinn, senior communications strategist at the Texas Freedom Network, a non-profit group that monitors public education.
items.stem: What does Quinn think of Hardy?
choices: She exaggerates the existing panic.
She denies the value of scientific work.
She shows no concern for pre-teens.
She expresses self-contradictory views
items.zh: "像她这样的委员会成员'随随便便就把学者和科学家毕生的研究斥为又一种被误导的观点'，"德州自由网络（一个监督公共教育的非营利组织）的高级传播策略师丹·奎因说道。

items.text: The world is going through the biggest wave of mergers and acquisitions ever witnessed. International affiliates account for a fast-growing segment of production in economies that open up and welcome foreign investment.
items.stem: What is the typical trend of businesses today?
choices: to take in more foreign funds
to invest more abroad
to combine and become bigger
to trade with more countries
items.zh: 世界正在经历一场有史以来规模最大的兼并与收购浪潮。在那些开放并欢迎外国投资的经济体中，国际子公司在生产中所占的份额正在快速增长。

items.text: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said he was leaving "to pursue my goal of running a company." Broadcasting his ambition was "very much my decision," McGee says.
items.stem: When McGee announced his departure, his manner can best be described as being
choices: arrogant.
frank.
self-centered.
impulsive.
items.zh: 他没有像往常那样用含糊的借口来掩饰离职，而是直截了当地说，他要离开是"为了追求经营一家公司的目标"。公开宣扬自己的抱负"完全是我自己的决定"，麦基说。

items.text: From the early days of broadband, advocates for consumers and web-based companies worried that the cable and phone companies selling broadband connections had the power and incentive to favor affiliated websites over their rivals. That's why there has been such a strong demand for rules that would prevent broadband providers from picking winners and losers online, preserving the freedom and innovation that have been the lifeblood of the internet.
items.stem: There has long been concern that broadband provides would ______ .
choices: bring web-based firms under control
slow down the traffic on their network
show partiality in treating clients
intensify competition with their rivals
items.zh: 从宽带发展的早期开始，消费者权益的倡导者以及基于网络的公司就担心：出售宽带接入服务的有线电视和电话公司有能力也有动机去偏袒与自己有关联的网站，而冷落竞争对手。这就是为什么人们如此强烈地要求制定相关规则，以阻止宽带提供商在网上挑选赢家和输家，从而保护那种一直作为互联网命脉的自由与创新。

items.text: The report, by John Houghton of Victoria University in Australia and Graham Vickery of the OECD, makes heavy reading for publishers who have, so far, made handsome profits. It signals a change in what has, until now, been a key element of scientific endeavour.
items.stem: Which of the following is true of the OECD report?
choices: It criticizes government-funded research.
It introduces an effective means of publication.
It upsets profit-making journal publishers.
It benefits scientific research considerably.
items.zh: 这份由澳大利亚维多利亚大学的约翰·霍顿和经合组织的格雷厄姆·维克里撰写的报告，对那些迄今赚得盆满钵满的出版商来说，读起来颇为沉重。它标志着迄今为止一直是科学探索关键要素的某种事物正在发生变化。

items.text: In a paper published in the Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry, researchers said that the western nuclear family was a recent invention which broke with evolutionary history. This abrupt shift to an"intensive mothering narrative", which suggests that mothers should manage childcare alone, was likely to have been harmful.“Such narratives can lead to maternal exhaustion and have dangerous consequences,” they wrote.
items.stem: According to Paragraph 4,the“intensive mothering narrative”
choices: alleviates parenting pressures
consolidates family relationships
results in the child-centred family
departs from the course of evolution
items.zh: 在一篇发表于《儿童心理学与精神病学杂志》的论文中，研究人员指出，西方的核心家庭是一种近期才出现的产物，它与人类进化史相背离。这种向"密集母职叙事"的突然转变——它暗示母亲应当独自承担育儿——很可能一直是有害的。他们写道："这类叙事会导致母亲精疲力竭，并带来危险的后果。"

items.text: As technology advances and a format becomes obsolete, the object is useless. Have you ever stared helplessly at a ZIP disk, thinking: how do I get the files off this?
items.stem: The “ZIP disk” is cited as an example to show .
choices: the difficulty of retrieving files through unusual means
the infeasibility of constantly migrating digital assets
the possibility of losing information in obsolete formats
the inconvenience of storing information on analog devices
items.zh: 随着技术的进步、某种格式逐渐过时，该对象便变得毫无用处。你是否曾无助地盯着一张ZIP磁盘，心里想着：我究竟怎样才能把里面的文件取出来呢？

items.text: These journals can act as milk cows where every single article in an issue may cite a specific paper or a series of papers. Such practices can lead an article to accrue more than 150 citations in the same year that it was published.
items.ctx: The birth of predatory journals wasn't far behind.
items.stem: The function of the ``milk cow'' journals is to ______ .
choices: boost citation counts for certain authors
help scholars publish articles at low cost
instruct first-time contributors in citation
increase the readership of new journals
items.zh: 这些期刊可充当“奶牛”：某一期中的每一篇文章都可能引用某一篇或一系列特定论文。这类做法能使一篇文章在其发表的同一年内累积超过150次引用。

items.text: In signing the measure, California Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional. The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an "important" policy interest, Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection".
items.stem: Which of the following is true of the Califormia measure?
choices: It has irritated private business owners.
It is welcomed by the Supreme Court.
It may go against the Constitution.
It will settle the prior controversies.
items.zh: 在签署该措施时，加州州长杰里·布朗承认，这项明确以性别为依据对人进行分类的法律很可能违宪。美国最高法院反对基于性别的分类，除非这些分类是为了应对某种“重要的”政策利益而设。由于加州法律适用于所有董事会，甚至适用于此前并无歧视历史的董事会，法院很可能裁定该法律违反了宪法对“平等保护”的保障。

choices: are less subject to their creators' neglect
convey information in a more direct way
require more intentional preservation
are less likely to suffer serious damage

items.stem: The personal grievance provisions of the ERA are intended to ______ .
choices: punish dubious corporate practices
improve traditional hiring procedures
exempt employers from certain duties
protect the rights of ordinary workers
items.zh: 设立个人申诉程序的目的，是保护普通劳动者的工作免遭“不公正解雇”。其前提是：合同普通法没有为劳动者提供足够的保护，使他们免受管理层专断行为的侵害。

items.text: Several massive leakages of customer and employee data this year—from organizations as diverse as Time Warner, the American defense contractor Science Applications International Corp and even the University of California, Berkeley—have left managers hurriedly peering into their intricate IT systems and business processes in search of potential vulnerabilities.
items.stem: According to Paragraph 2, some organizations check their systems to find out
choices: whether there is any weak point.
what sort of data has been stolen.
who is responsible for the leakage.
how the potential spies can be located.
items.zh: 今年发生的几起客户与员工数据大规模泄露事件——涉及时代华纳、美国国防承包商科学应用国际公司，甚至加州大学伯克利分校等形形色色的组织——已使管理者们匆忙审视其错综复杂的 IT 系统和业务流程，以查找潜在的漏洞。

items.text: And it's a reminder that the EPA's involvement in the Chesapeake Bay Program has long been crucial as the means to transcend the influence of deep-pocketed special interests in neighboring states. items.ctx: That seems unlikely, It is too easy, and misleading, to see such court rulings as merely standing up for the rights of land owners when the consequences can be so dire for their neighbors.
items.stem: What can be inferred about the EPA's involvement in the Chesapeake Bay Program?
choices: It has restored the balance among neighboring jurisdictions.
It has triggered a radical reform in commercial fisheries.
It has set a fine example of respecting state authorities.
It has ensured the coordination of protection efforts.
items.zh: 而且它提醒人们：环保署对切萨皮克湾项目的参与长期以来一直至关重要，是超越邻州财大气粗的特殊利益集团影响的一种手段。举一个有说服力的例子来说，宾夕法尼亚州的农民在决定是否往自家田地里撒动物粪肥时，并不会去想马里兰州明年的蓝蟹收成；然而流入附近溪流的径流却能对下游产生巨大的影响。

items.text: Visit any antiques store and you'll encounter artifacts from the past: photographs, letters, a brochure detailing the Sinclair dinosaur exhibit from the 1964-1965 World's Fair, the ephemera of history. items.stem: The author mentions the artifacts from the past to .
choices: introduce the coming of antiques
contrast them with everyday items
bring up the issue of preservation
comment on their historical value
items.zh: 走进任何一家古董店，你都会遇到来自过去的器物：照片、信件、一本详细介绍1964—1965年世界博览会辛克莱恐龙展的小册子，这些都是历史的零碎遗存。鉴于那些制造这些器物的人很少为其长期保存做出安排，你是否思考过无形格式（即数字信息）的生命周期呢？

items.text: Because representative government presupposes an informed citizenry, the report supports full literacy; stresses the study of history and government, particularly American history and American government; and encourages the use of new digital technologies.
items.stem: According to Paragraph 3, the report suggests

a greater emphasis on theoretical subjects.
the application of emerging technologies.
funding for the study of foreign languages.
items.zh: 由于代议制政府以了解情况的公民群体为前提，报告支持完全的读写能力，强调研究历史和政治学（尤其是美国历史和美国政治），并鼓励使用新的数字技术。

items.text: The Republican penned order not only eliminated the strict net neutrality rules the FCC had adopted when it had a Democratic majority in 2015, but rejected the commission's authority to require broadband providers to do much of anything. items.stem: Faced with the demand for net neutrality rules, the FCC ______ .
choices: sticks to an out-of-date order
takes an anti-regulatory stance
has issued a special resolution
has allowed the states to intervene
items.zh: 这份由共和党人起草的法令，不仅废除了FCC在2015年占据民主党多数席位时所采纳的严格网络中立规则，还否定了该委员会要求宽带提供商做几乎任何事情的权力。该法令还宣称，州和地方政府同样也不能对宽带提供商进行监管。

items.text: Finally, because the ultimate stakeholders are patients, the health research community should actively recruit to its cause not only well-known personalities such as Stephen Cooper, who has made courageous statements about the value of animal research, but all who receive medical treatment.

choices: a well-known humanist
a medical practitioner
an enthusiast in animal rights
a supporter of animal research
items.zh: 最后，由于最终的利益相关者是患者，健康研究界应当积极地为其事业招募人员，不仅包括像斯蒂芬·库珀这样曾就动物研究的价值发表过勇敢声明的知名人士，还包括所有接受医疗的人。

resenting unfairness is also monkeys’ nature.

protect the rights of ordinary workers

less controversial
less severe
more lasting
items.zh: 该研究发现，在被起诉的公司中，那些拥有最全面CSR项目的公司往往会受到较轻的处罚。一位研究者说：“我们估计，无论是消除某项重大劳工权益问题（如使用童工），还是把企业捐赠增加约20%，所带来的罚款通常都比贿赂外国官员的典型处罚低40%。”

items.text: Fundamentally, the USPS is in a historic squeeze between technological change that has permanently decreased demand for its bread-and-butter product, first-class mail, and a regulatory structure that denies management the flexibility to adjust its operations to the new reality.

choices: its unbalanced budget
its rigid management
the cost for technical upgrading
the withdrawal of bank support
items.zh: 从根本上说，美国邮政局正处于一种历史性的挤压之中：一边是永久性地降低了对其主打产品（即一类邮件）需求的技术变革，另一边是使管理层无法灵活地根据新现实调整运营的监管结构。

choices: fascinates AI scientists all over the world
has remained popular for as long as 200 years
involves some concerns raised by AI today
has sparked serious ethical controversies

items.text: Officials must not be allowed to play favorites in providing information or in arranging meetings simply because an individual or group provides a campaign donation or a personal gift. This type of integrity requires well-enforced laws in government transparency, such as records of official meetings, rules on lobbying, and information about each elected leader's source of wealth.
items.stem: Well-enforced laws in government transparency are needed to ______ .
choices: awaken the conscience of officials
guarantee fair play in official access
allow for certain kinds of lobbying
inspire hopes in average people
items.zh: 决不能仅仅因为某个人或团体提供了竞选捐款或私人礼物，就允许官员在提供信息或安排会面时厚此薄彼。这种廉正需要在政府透明度方面有得到切实执行的法律，例如官方会议记录、游说规则，以及有关每位民选领导人财富来源的信息。

items.text: The Republican penned order not only eliminated the strict net neutrality rules the FCC had adopted when it had a Democratic majority in 2015, but rejected the commission's authority to require broadband providers to do much of anything. choices: sticks to an out-of-date order
takes an anti-regulatory stance
has issued a special resolution
has allowed the states to intervene
items.zh: 这份由共和党人起草的法令，不仅废除了FCC在2015年占据民主党多数席位时所采纳的严格网络中立规则，还否定了该委员会要求宽带提供商做几乎任何事情的权力。该法令还宣称，州和地方政府同样也不能对宽带提供商进行监管。

items.text: Not only does understanding the equines'genetic makeup help reveal their contributions to human history, but it also might improve their management in the future, as climate change alters the planet's environment, write the authors.

better management of donkeys.
recovering early types of donkeys.
raising awareness of climate change.

frustrated with family earnings.

poor bargaining skill.
lack of imagination.

unpleasant.
entertaining.
commercial.

the government's reluctance to back it

items.stem: The author suggests that tax policies be aimed at ______ .
choices: encouraging the development of automation
increasing the return on capital investment
easing the hostility between rich and poor
preventing the income gap from widening
items.zh: 最后，由于自动化有可能扩大资本收入与劳动收入之间的差距，税收和社会保障网将不得不重新加以审视。低薪劳动的税收需要削减，工资补贴（如劳动所得税抵免）应当扩大：这将提高收入、鼓励就业、奖励创造就业岗位的企业，并减少不平等。

items.text: On first hearing, this was the socially concerned chancellor, trying to change lives for the better, complete with "reforms" to an obviously indulgent system that demands too little effort from the newly unemployed to find work, and subsidises laziness. items.stem: What prompted the chancellor to develop his scheme?
choices: A desire to secure a better life for all.
An eagerness to protect the unemployed.
An urge to be generous to the claimants.
A passion to ensure fairness for taxpayers.
items.zh: 乍一听，这就是那位关心社会、努力改善人们生活的财政大臣，他还对一个明显纵容的制度推行了"改革"——该制度对新失业者找工作的要求太少，反而纵容了懒惰。我们将会明白，促使他这么做的，是他对"根本公平"的热忱——保护纳税人、控制开支，并确保只有最应得救济的申领者才能领到他们的救济金。

items.text: As countless boards and business owners will attest, constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance. items.stem: Which of the following measures would the Productivity Commission support?
choices: Imposing reasonable wage restraints.
Enforcing employment protection laws.
Limiting the powers of business owners.
Dismissing poorly performing managers.
items.zh: 正如无数董事会和企业主都会证实的那样，限制企业解雇业绩不佳的高薪经理，是阻碍提高生产率和整体绩效的一道手刹。事实上，生产率委员会在2014年的《新西兰生产率悖论的国际视角》一文中，将管理能力低下列为该国生产率增长乏力的一个原因。

qualified to deal independently with bureaucratic issues
justified in addressing the needs of their constituents
exempt from conviction on the charge of favoritism

items.stem: What is commonly regarded as the cause of grade inflation?
choices: The change of course catalogs.
Students' indifference to GPAs.
Colleges' neglect of GPAs.
The influence of consumer culture.
items.zh: 分数膨胀——即过去几十年里平均绩点（GPA）的逐渐上升——常被视为高等教育消费时代的产物，在这个时代里，学生被当作需要取悦的顾客来对待。

items.text: The price of nails fell by 90% between the late 1700s and mid-1900s, as economist Daniel Sichel points out in a research paper. According to Sichel, although the falling price of nails was driven partly by cheaper iron and cheaper energy, most of the credit goes to nail manufacturers who simply found more efficient ways to turn steel into nails.
items.stem: What played the major role in lowering the price of nails after the late 1700s?
choices: Increased productivity.
Wider use of new energies.
Fiercer market competition.
Reduced cost of raw materials.
items.zh: 正如经济学家丹尼尔·西歇尔在一篇研究论文中所指出的那样，钉子的价格在18世纪末到20世纪中叶之间下降了90%。据西歇尔说，尽管钉子价格的下降部分得益于更便宜的铁和更便宜的能源，但大部分功劳要归于那些找到更高效方法把钢材制成钉子的钉子制造商。

items.text: Superhigh scores like vos Savant's are no longer possible, because scoring is now based on a statistical population distribution among age peers, rather than simply dividing the mental age by the chronological age and multiplying by 100. In his article "How Intelligent Is Intelligence Testing?", Sternberg notes that traditional tests best assess analytical and verbal skills but fail to measure creativity and practical knowledge, components also critical to problem solving and life success.
items.stem: People nowadays can no longer achieve IQ scores as high as vos Savant’s because
choices: the scores are obtained through different computational procedures.
creativity rather than analytical skills is emphasized now.
vos Savant’s case is an extreme one that will not repeat.
the defining characteristic of IQ tests has changed.
items.zh: 像沃斯·莎凡特那样的超高分已不再可能出现，因为如今的评分是基于同龄人群体的统计学分布，而不再是简单地用心理年龄除以实际年龄再乘以100。斯滕伯格在他题为《智力测试究竟有多智能？》的文章中指出，传统测试最擅长评估分析能力和语言能力，却无法衡量创造力和实践知识，而这些也是解决问题和取得人生成功的关键要素。

items.text: Employers have long seen the advantages of hiring school leavers who often prove themselves to be more committed and loyal employees than graduates. Many too are seeing the advantages of scrapping a degree requirement for certain roles.
items.stem: The author considers it a good sign that ______ .
choices: Generation Z are seeking to earn a decent degree
School leavers are willing to be skilled workers
Employers are taking a realistic attitude to degrees
Parents are changing their minds about education
items.zh: 雇主们早就看到了雇用中学毕业生的好处，这些人往往证明自己是比大学毕业生更敬业、更忠诚的员工。许多雇主也开始看到，针对某些岗位取消学位要求所带来的好处。

items.text: Why had the Romans buried a million nails? The likely explanation is that the withdrawal was rushed, and they didn't want the local Caledonians getting their hands on 10 tons of weapon-grade iron.
items.stem: The Romans buried the nails probably for the sake of
choices: saving them for future use
keeping them from rusting
letting them grow in value
hiding them from the locals
items.zh: 罗马人为什么要埋下一百万枚钉子呢？可能的解释是：撤退太过仓促，而且他们不想让当地的喀里多尼亚人弄到这10吨武器级别的铁。

items.text: One more reason not to lose sleep over the rise in oil prices is that, unlike the rises in the 1970s, it has not occurred against the background of general commodity-price inflation and global excess demand.
items.stem: We can draw a conclusion from the text that_______.?
choices: oil-price shocks are less shocking now
inflation seems irrelevant to oil-price shocks
energy conservation can keep down the oil prices
the price rise of crude leads to the shrinking of heavy industry
items.zh: 不必为油价上涨而焦虑的另一个理由是：与20世纪70年代的几次上涨不同，这次上涨并非发生在普遍的大宗商品价格通胀和全球需求过剩的背景之下。

items.text: The Republican penned order not only eliminated the strict net neutrality rules the FCC had adopted when it had a Democratic majority in 2015, but rejected the commission's authority to require broadband providers to do much of anything. The order also declared that state and local governments couldn't regulate broadband providers either.
items.stem: Faced with the demand for net neutrality rules, the FCC ______ .
choices: sticks to an out-of-date order
takes an anti-regulatory stance
has issued a special resolution
has allowed the states to intervene
items.zh: 这份由共和党人起草的法令，不仅废除了FCC在2015年占据民主党多数席位时所采纳的严格网络中立规则，还否定了该委员会要求宽带提供商做几乎任何事情的权力。该法令还宣称，州和地方政府同样也不能对宽带提供商进行监管。

items.text: Not only does understanding the equines'genetic makeup help reveal their contributions to human history, but it also might improve their management in the future, as climate change alters the planet's environment, write the authors.
items.stem: The authors think that their research could help with_____.
choices: greater protection of wildlife.
better management of donkeys.
recovering early types of donkeys.
raising awareness of climate change.
items.zh: 作者写道，理解这些马科动物的基因组成不仅有助于揭示它们对人类历史的贡献，而且随着气候变化改变地球环境，还可能改善对它们未来的管理。

items.text: Just how people think is still far too complex to be understood, let alone reproduced, says David Eagleman, a Stanford University neuroscientist. "We are just in a situation where there are no good theories explaining what consciousness actually is and how you could ever build a machine to get there."
items.stem: In David Eagleman's opinion, our current knowledge of consciousness ______ .
choices: helps explain artificial intelligence
can be misleading to robot making
inspires popular sci-fi TV series
is too limited for us to reproduce it
items.zh: 斯坦福大学神经科学家戴维·伊格曼说，人类究竟如何思考至今仍过于复杂而难以被理解，更遑论复制。“我们正处于这样一种境地：没有任何完善的理论能够解释意识究竟是什么，以及人们究竟如何才能造出一台机器去实现意识。”

items.text: Nostalgia for ink on paper and the rustle of pages aside, there's plenty of incentive to ditch print. The infrastructure required to make a physical newspaper—printing presses, delivery trucks—isn't just expensive; it's excessive at a time when online-only competitors don't have the same set of financial constraints.
items.stem: The New York Times is considering ending its print edition partly due to ______ .
choices: the high cost of operation
the pressure from its investors
the complaints from its readers
the increasing online ad sales
items.zh: 撇开对纸上油墨和翻页沙沙声的怀念不谈，放弃纸质印刷有着大量充足的理由。制作一份实体报纸所需的基础设施——印刷机、运货卡车——不仅昂贵，而且在纯线上竞争对手并不受同样一套财务约束的当下，它更显得过度奢侈。

items.text: But in keeping with our examination of southern intellectual life, we may consider the original Puritans as carriers of European culture, adjusting to New World circumstances.
items.stem: It is suggested in Paragraph 2 that New Englanders
choices: experienced a comparatively peaceful early history.
brought with them the culture of the Old World.
paid little attention to southern intellectual life.
were obsessed with religious innovations.
items.zh: 但为了与我们对南方智识生活的考察保持一致，我们可以把最初的清教徒视为欧洲文化的传播者，他们正在适应新大陆的环境。

items.text: These agencies and other government bodies should dramatically improve incentives to keep our current shows and attract new productions to Los Angeles. Let's go on with the show…and make sure the show doesn't go on without us.
items.ctx: That's why the California Film Commission and its Los Angeles counterpart, Film LA, now should act now, before it's too late.
items.stem: The author concludes the text by emphasizing that California should strive to_____.
choices: maintain its position in the industry.
attract more investment than its rivals.
pursue a higher standard of production.
strengthen coordination with other states.
items.zh: 这些机构和其他政府机构应该大幅提高激励措施，以留住我们现有的节目并吸引新的制作到洛杉矶。让我们继续演出……并确保演出不会在没有我们的情况下继续。

items.text: While polls show Britons rate "the countryside" alongside the royal family. Shakespeare and the National Health Service (NHS) as what makes them proudest of their country, this has limited political support.
items.stem: Britain's public sentiment about the countryside ______ .
choices: didn't start till the Shakespearean age
has brought much benefit to the NHS
is fully backed by the royal family
is not well reflected in politics
items.zh: 尽管民调显示英国人将“乡村”与王室相提并论……（英国人）将莎士比亚和国民医疗服务体系（NHS）视为最让他们为国家感到骄傲的东西，但这种情感在政治上获得的支持却很有限。

items.text: A deal is a deal—except, apparently, when Entergy is involved. The company, a major energy supplier in New England, provoked justified outrage in Vermont last week when it announced it was reneging on a longstanding commitment to abide by the state's strict nuclear regulations.
items.stem: The phrase “reneging on” (Line 3, Para. 1) is closest in meaning to
choices: condemning.
reaffirming.
dishonoring.
securing.
items.zh: 说话本应算数——但显然，一旦涉及 Entergy 公司，情况就另当别论了。这家公司是新英格兰地区一家主要的能源供应商，上周它宣布背弃长期以来遵守该州严格核管理规定的承诺，在佛蒙特州激起了人们正当的愤怒。

items.text: Joana Lia Ferreira, an assistant professor of conservation and restoration at the nova School of Science and Technology, notes that archaeologists first defined the great material ages of human history Stone Age, Iron Age, and so on after examining artifacts in museums. We now live in an age of plastic, she says, "and what we decide to collect today, what we decide to preserve will have a strong impact on how in the future we'll be seen."
items.stem: In Ferreira's opinion, preservation of plastic artifacts ______ .
choices: will inspire future scientific research
has profound historical significance
will help us separate the material ages
has an impact on today's cultural life
items.zh: 新星科学与技术学院保护与修复学助理教授若阿娜·莉亚·费雷拉指出，考古学家正是在考察了博物馆中的文物之后，才首次界定了人类历史上几大重要的物质时代——石器时代、铁器时代等等。她说，我们如今生活在一个塑料的时代，“而我们今天决定收集什么、决定保存什么，将会对未来人们如何看待我们产生重大影响。”

items.text: In signing the measure, California Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional. The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an "important" policy interest, Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection".
items.stem: Which of the following is true of the Califormia measure?
choices: It has irritated private business owners.
It is welcomed by the Supreme Court.
It may go against the Constitution.
It will settle the prior controversies.
items.zh: 在签署该措施时，加州州长杰里·布朗承认，这项明确以性别为依据对人进行分类的法律很可能违宪。美国最高法院反对基于性别的分类，除非这些分类是为了应对某种“重要的”政策利益而设。由于加州法律适用于所有董事会，甚至适用于此前并无歧视历史的董事会，法院很可能裁定该法律违反了宪法对“平等保护”的保障。

items.text: As countless boards and business owners will attest, constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance. Indeed, in "An International Perspective on New Zealand's Productivity Paradox" (2014), the Productivity Commission singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause of the country's poor productivity growth record.
items.stem: Which of the following measures would the Productivity Commission support?
choices: Imposing reasonable wage restraints.
Enforcing employment protection laws.
Limiting the powers of business owners.
Dismissing poorly performing managers.
items.zh: 正如无数董事会和企业主都会证实的那样，限制企业解雇业绩不佳的高薪经理，是阻碍提高生产率和整体绩效的一道手刹。事实上，生产率委员会在2014年的《新西兰生产率悖论的国际视角》一文中，将管理能力低下列为该国生产率增长乏力的一个原因。

items.text: It is against that background that the information commissioner, Elizabeth Denham, has issued her damning verdict against the Royal Free Hospital trust under the NHS, which handed over to DeepMind the records of 1.6 million patients in 2015 on the basis of a vague agreement which took far too little account of the patients' rights and their expectations of privacy.
items.ctx: The potential of this work applied to healthcare is very great, but it could also lead to further concentration of power in the tech giants.
items.stem: What is true of the agreement between the NHS and DeepMind?
choices: It caused conflicts among tech giants.
It failed to pay due attention to patients' rights.
It fell short of the latter's expectations.
It put both sides into a dangerous situation.
items.zh: 正是在那样的背景下，信息专员伊丽莎白·德纳姆才对 NHS 下属的皇家自由医院信托发布了她的严厉裁定——该信托于 2015 年依据一份含糊的协议将 160 万名患者的记录移交给了 DeepMind，而那份协议远远没有充分顾及患者的权利及其对隐私的期待。

items.text: A cartoon mocks a group failing to converse because they're all in headphones. Today we fret about the isolating culture of smartphone-staring and selfie-vanity, but already in 1939 there was that lady regretting how, when all her street got wireless, it lost the neighbourly habit of “talking on the brush handle”.
items.stem: The expression “talking on the brush handle” in Paragraphs 3 and 6 refers to the act of_____.
choices: making a loud noise.
having a casual chat.
starting a trivial quarrel.
humming a popular song.
items.zh: 一幅漫画嘲笑了一群人，他们因为都戴着耳机而无法交谈。如今我们为沉迷手机和自拍虚荣的孤立文化而烦恼，但早在1939年，就有一位女士感叹，当整条街都用上无线电后，邻里间“隔着扫帚柄聊天”的习惯就消失了。

items.text: Their thinking often had a traditional superstitious quality.
items.ctx: While few craftsmen or farmers, let alone dependents and servants, left literary compositions to be analyzed, it is obvious that their views were less fully intellectualized.
items.stem: The story of John Dane shows that less well-educated New Englanders were  often
choices: influenced by superstitions.
troubled with religious beliefs.
puzzled by church sermons.
frustrated with family earnings.
items.zh: 他们的思维常常带有一种传统的迷信色彩。

items.text: Because representative government presupposes an informed citizenry, the report supports full literacy; stresses the study of history and government, particularly American history and American government; and encourages the use of new digital technologies.
items.stem: According to Paragraph 3, the report suggests
choices: an exclusive study of American history.
a greater emphasis on theoretical subjects.
the application of emerging technologies.
funding for the study of foreign languages.
items.zh: 由于代议制政府以了解情况的公民群体为前提，报告支持完全的读写能力，强调研究历史和政治学（尤其是美国历史和美国政治），并鼓励使用新的数字技术。

items.text: But Judge Patricia Millett rightly argued in a concurring opinion that "the result is unhinged from the realities of modern broadband service," and said Congress or the Supreme Court could intervene to "avoid trapping Internet regulation in technological anachronism."
items.stem: Judge Patricia Millett argues that the appeals court's decision ______ .
choices: focuses on trivialities
conveys an ambiguous message
is at odds with its earlier rulings
is out of touch with reality
items.zh: 但帕特里夏·米莱特法官在一份附议意见中正确地指出，“这一结果脱离了现代宽带服务的现实”，并表示国会或最高法院可以介入，以“避免使互联网监管陷入技术上的时代错位”。

items.text: Specialisation can be seen as a response to the problem of an increasing accumulation of scientific knowledge.
items.stem: The direct reason for specialisation is _______.
choices: the development in communication
the growth of professionalisation
the expansion of scientific knowledge
the splitting up of academic societies
items.zh: 专业化可以被看作是对科学知识不断积累这一问题的一种应对。

items.text: The price of nails fell by 90% between the late 1700s and mid-1900s, as economist Daniel Sichel points out in a research paper. According to Sichel, although the falling price of nails was driven partly by cheaper iron and cheaper energy, most of the credit goes to nail manufacturers who simply found more efficient ways to turn steel into nails.
items.stem: What played the major role in lowering the price of nails after the late 1700s?
choices: Increased productivity.
Wider use of new energies.
Fiercer market competition.
Reduced cost of raw materials.
items.zh: 正如经济学家丹尼尔·西歇尔在一篇研究论文中所指出的那样，钉子的价格在18世纪末到20世纪中叶之间下降了90%。据西歇尔说，尽管钉子价格的下降部分得益于更便宜的铁和更便宜的能源，但大部分功劳要归于那些找到更高效方法把钢材制成钉子的钉子制造商。

items.text: The BBC director-general Sir John Reith said that it would dispel “isolation of the spirit” and rejoiced: “It does not matter how many thousands may be listening, there is always enough for others … the genius and the fool, the wealthy and the poor listen simultaneously.” Between two great wars this technological innovation built a new kind of national consciousness.
items.stem: What can be learnt about wireless from Reith?
choices: It was accessible to everyone.
It improved interpersonal relations.
It was a miracle of human ingenuity.
It led to a new era of isolating culture.
items.zh: BBC总裁约翰·里思爵士说，它将驱散“精神上的孤立”，并高兴地表示：“无论有多少人在听，总有足够的给其他人……天才和傻瓜，富人和穷人同时收听。”在两次世界大战之间，这项技术创新建立了一种新的民族意识。

items.text: This practice does not address the real worry. What matters is that they will belong to a private monopoly which developed them using public resources.
items.ctx: The use of privacy law to curb the tech giants in this instance feels slightly maladapted.
items.stem: According to the last paragraph, the real worry arising from this deal is ______ .
choices: the vicious rivalry among big pharmas
the ineffective enforcement of privacy law
the uncontrolled use of new software
the monopoly of big data by tech giants
items.zh: 这种做法并未触及真正令人担忧的问题。真正重要的是，这些算法将归属于一家利用公共资源开发出它们的私人垄断企业。

items.text: The financial fallout has begun, and the political fallout may not be far behind.
items.stem: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that
choices: financial risks tend to outweigh political risks.
the middle class may face greater political challenges.
financial problems may bring about political problems.
financial responsibility is an indicator of political status.
items.zh: 经济上的连锁后果已经开始显现，而政治上的连锁后果也可能为时不远。

items.text: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already. Now, rivals will be charging sales tax where they hadn't before.
items.stem: Who are most likely to welcome the Supreme Court ruling?
choices: Internet entrepreneurs.
Big-chain owners.
Third-party sellers.
Small retailers.
items.zh: 这项裁决对在许多州都设有业务的大型连锁企业来说是一场胜利，因为它们通常本来就已经对网上购物征收销售税了。如今，竞争对手将在以前不曾征税的地方开始征收销售税。

items.text: Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities — de facto hotels — to bypass taxes and regulations. "I think the question is, shouldn't a developer who's really building a hotel, but disguising it as not a hotel, be treated and taxed and regulated like a hotel?" Horn said.
items.stem: What does Horn emphasize in Paragraph 5?
choices: The urgency to upgrade short-term rental facilities.
The efficient operation of the local housing market.
The necessity to stop developers from evading taxes.
The proper procedures for renting out spare houses.
items.zh: 然而，当开发商试图建造大规模的短租设施——实际上就是酒店——以规避税收和监管时，问题就出现了。“我认为，问题在于：一个实际上在建酒店、却把它伪装成非酒店的开发商，难道不应该像酒店一样被对待、征税和监管吗？”霍恩说。

items.text: People in earlier eras were surrounded by reminders of misery. Given all this, they did not exactly need their art to be a bummer too.
items.stem: The word “bummer” (Line 5, Paragraph 5) most probably means something
choices: religious.
unpleasant.
entertaining.
commercial.
items.zh: 早先时代的人们被种种提示苦难的事物所包围。鉴于这一切，他们实在不需要连艺术也来扫他们的兴。

items.text: But science does provide us with the best available guide to the future, and it is critical that our nation and the world base important policies on the best judgments that science can provide concerning the future consequences of present actions."
items.stem: According to Bruce Alberts, science can serve as
choices: a protector.
a judge.
a critic.
a guide.
items.zh: 但科学确实为我们提供了通往未来的最佳现有指引，而至关重要的是，我们的国家乃至全世界都应依据科学就当前行动的未来后果所能提供的最佳判断，来制定重要政策。

items.text: Recently, another expression of this predatory behavior has emerged: so-called support service consultancies that provide language and other editorial support to individual authors and to journals sometimes advise contributors to add a number of citations to their articles.
items.stem: The support service consultancies tend to ______ .
choices: recommend journals to their clients
list citation patterns for their clients
ask authors to include extra citations
advise contributors to cite each other
items.zh: 最近，这种掠夺性行为的另一种表现已经出现：那些为个人作者和期刊提供语言及其他编辑支持的所谓支持服务咨询机构，有时会建议投稿者在其文章中添加若干引用。

items.text: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets.
items.stem: The word “about-face” (Line 1, Para. 3) most probably means
choices: loss of goodwill.
increase of hostility.
change of attitude.
enhancement of dignity.
items.zh: 对商业方法权利主张加以限制将是一次戏剧性的 180 度大逆转，因为正是联邦巡回法院自己通过其在所谓“道富银行案”中的 1998 年裁决引入了此类专利，该裁决批准了一项关于汇集共同基金资产方法的专利。

items.text: Their thinking often had a traditional superstitious quality.
items.ctx: While few craftsmen or farmers, let alone dependents and servants, left literary compositions to be analyzed, it is obvious that their views were less fully intellectualized.
items.stem: The story of John Dane shows that less well-educated New Englanders were  often
choices: influenced by superstitions.
troubled with religious beliefs.
puzzled by church sermons.
frustrated with family earnings.
items.zh: 他们的思维常常带有一种传统的迷信色彩。

items.text: Yet only one of his books is now in print, and his vast body of writings on music is unknown save to specialists. Journalistic tastes had changed long before his death, and postmodern readers have little use for the richly upholstered Vicwardian prose in which he specialized.
items.stem: What can be learned about Cardus according to the last two paragraphs?
choices: His music criticism may not appeal to readers today.
His reputation as a music critic has long been in dispute.
His style caters largely to modern specialists.
His writings fail to follow the amateur tradition.
items.zh: 然而如今他只有一本书还在印行，而他大量的音乐论著除了专家之外几乎无人知晓。不过，早在他去世之前很久，新闻品味就已经改变了，而后现代读者对他所擅长的那种辞藻华丽、繁复堆砌的维多利亚-爱德华时代散文几乎毫无兴趣。

items.text: The carbon emissions from technological research are well spent: ultimately this research will safeguard the future of our planet.
items.stem: The author believes that carbon emissions from research .
choices: have caused grave consequences
have aroused groundless worries
are hard to handle at present
are justifiable in the long run
items.zh: 技术研究所产生的碳排放是物有所值的：归根结底，这项研究将守护我们星球的未来。

items.text: Superhigh scores like vos Savant's are no longer possible, because scoring is now based on a statistical population distribution among age peers, rather than simply dividing the mental age by the chronological age and multiplying by 100. In his article "How Intelligent Is Intelligence Testing?", Sternberg notes that traditional tests best assess analytical and verbal skills but fail to measure creativity and practical knowledge, components also critical to problem solving and life success.
items.stem: People nowadays can no longer achieve IQ scores as high as vos Savant’s because
choices: the scores are obtained through different computational procedures.
creativity rather than analytical skills is emphasized now.
vos Savant’s case is an extreme one that will not repeat.
the defining characteristic of IQ tests has changed.
items.zh: 像沃斯·莎凡特那样的超高分已不再可能出现，因为如今的评分是基于同龄人群体的统计学分布，而不再是简单地用心理年龄除以实际年龄再乘以100。斯滕伯格在他题为《智力测试究竟有多智能？》的文章中指出，传统测试最擅长评估分析能力和语言能力，却无法衡量创造力和实践知识，而这些也是解决问题和取得人生成功的关键要素。

items.text: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads.
items.stem: It can be learned that streamers like Netflix .
choices: played a part in the fight against illegal file-sharing
reaped benefits from the war with digital pirates
promised to become big job creators in the US
used to collaborate with file-uploading platforms

items.zh: 2010年，国会中主要的民主党人和共和党人致信美国艺术与科学院，要求该院确认"联邦、州和地方政府、大学、基金会、教育者、个人资助者及其他方面"可以采取哪些行动，以"维持国家在人文学科与社会科学的学术和教育方面的卓越水平"。

items.text: The best lawyers made skyscrapers-full of money, tempting ever more students to pile into law schools.
items.stem: A lot of students take up law as their profession due to
choices: the growing demand from clients.
the increasing pressure of inflation.
the prospect of working in big firms.
the attraction of financial rewards.
items.zh: 最优秀的律师赚得盆满钵满，从而吸引越来越多的学生涌入法学院。

items.text: Not only does understanding the equines'genetic makeup help reveal their contributions to human history, but it also might improve their management in the future, as climate change alters the planet's environment, write the authors.
items.stem: The authors think that their research could help with_____.
choices: greater protection of wildlife.
better management of donkeys.
recovering early types of donkeys.
raising awareness of climate change.
items.zh: 作者写道，理解这些马科动物的基因组成不仅有助于揭示它们对人类历史的贡献，而且随着气候变化改变地球环境，还可能改善对它们未来的管理。

items.text: But when Swetnam enrolled in graduate school at the University of Arizona's Laboratory of Tree-Ring Research, he was surprised to find a record of repeated blazes dating back hundreds of years before European colonists arrived on the continent.
items.stem: According to Paragraph 1, Swetnam was surprised by_____.
choices: the scarcity of tree-ring research in the U.S.
the firefighting measures in ancient Europe.
the forest management practices in the 1970s.
the number of wildfires in precolonial times.
items.zh: 但当斯韦特南在亚利桑那大学树木年轮研究实验室读研究生时，他惊讶地发现了一份记录，显示在欧洲殖民者到达这片大陆之前数百年，火灾就反复发生。

items.text: Curriculums—from grammar school to college—should evolve to focus less on memorizing facts and more on creativity and complex communication.
items.stem: Education in the age of automation should put more emphasis on ______ .
choices: creative potential
job-hunting skills
individual needs
cooperative spirit
items.zh: 课程设置——从小学到大学——应当不断演进，少强调死记硬背事实，多强调创造力和复杂的沟通能力。

items.text: Both France and the United States are involved in the organization's work, but France's digital services tax and the American response raise questions about what the future holds for the international tax system.
items.ctx: In response to these many unilateral measures, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) is currently working with 131 countries to reach a consensus by the end of 2020 on an international solution.
items.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 5 that the OECD's current work ______ .
choices: is being resisted by US companies
needs to be readjusted immediately
is faced with uncertain prospects
needs to in involve more countries
items.zh: 法国和美国都参与了该组织的工作，但法国的数字服务税和美国的回应引发了关于国际税收体系未来走向的疑问。

items.text: At a time when Thomas Piketty and other economists are warning of rising inequality and the increasing power of inherited wealth, it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.
items.stem: Which of the following is shown to be odd, according to Paragraph 4?
choices: Aristocrats’ excessive reliance on inherited wealth.
The role of the nobility in modern democracies.
The simple lifestyle of the aristocratic families.
The nobility’s adherence to their privileges.
items.zh: 在托马斯·皮凯蒂等经济学家纷纷警告不平等日益加剧、继承财富的力量不断增强之际，富有的贵族家庭竟然仍是现代民主国家象征性的核心，这实在令人匪夷所思。

items.text: Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity, leading to lives of fulfilment and opportunity for all.
items.stem: Our vision of the future used to be inspired by
choices: our desire for lives of fulfillment.
our faith in science and technology.
our awareness of potential risks.
our belief in equal opportunity.
items.zh: 科学技术将治愈人类所有的弊病，从而让所有人都能过上充实且充满机遇的生活。

items.text: The report, by John Houghton of Victoria University in Australia and Graham Vickery of the OECD, makes heavy reading for publishers who have, so far, made handsome profits. It signals a change in what has, until now, been a key element of scientific endeavour.
items.stem: Which of the following is true of the OECD report?
choices: It criticizes government-funded research.
It introduces an effective means of publication.
It upsets profit-making journal publishers.
It benefits scientific research considerably.
items.zh: 这份由澳大利亚维多利亚大学的约翰·霍顿和经合组织的格雷厄姆·维克里撰写的报告，对那些迄今赚得盆满钵满的出版商来说，读起来颇为沉重。它标志着迄今为止一直是科学探索关键要素的某种事物正在发生变化。

items.text: A cartoon mocks a group failing to converse because they're all in headphones. Today we fret about the isolating culture of smartphone-staring and selfie-vanity, but already in 1939 there was that lady regretting how, when all her street got wireless, it lost the neighbourly habit of “talking on the brush handle”.
items.stem: The expression “talking on the brush handle” in Paragraphs 3 and 6 refers to the act of_____.
choices: making a loud noise.
having a casual chat.
starting a trivial quarrel.
humming a popular song.
items.zh: 一幅漫画嘲笑了一群人，他们因为都戴着耳机而无法交谈。如今我们为沉迷手机和自拍虚荣的孤立文化而烦恼，但早在1939年，就有一位女士感叹，当整条街都用上无线电后，邻里间“隔着扫帚柄聊天”的习惯就消失了。

items.text: And this process need not be left to the unconscious. Visualize how you would like it to end instead; the next time it occurs, try to wake up just enough to control its course.
items.stem: Cartwright seems to suggest that
choices: waking up in time is essential to the ridding of bad dreams.
visualizing bad dreams helps bring them under control.
dreams should be left to their natural progression.
dreaming may not entirely belong to the unconscious.
items.zh: 而且这一过程不必完全交由潜意识来处理。想象一下你希望它换个什么样的结局；下次它再出现时，试着醒到刚好能控制其走向的程度。

items.text: Since the dawn of human ingenuity, people have devised ever more cunning tools to cope with work that is dangerous, boring, burdensome, or just plain nasty.
items.stem: Human ingenuity was initially demonstrated in? .
choices: the use of machines to produce science fiction
the wide use of machines in manufacturing industry
the invention of tools for difficult and dangerous work
the elite's cunning tackling of dangerous and boring work
items.zh: 自从人类智慧萌发以来，人们就设计出越来越精巧的工具，用以应对那些危险、乏味、繁重或者干脆就令人厌恶的工作。

items.text: This practice does not address the real worry. What matters is that they will belong to a private monopoly which developed them using public resources.
items.ctx: The use of privacy law to curb the tech giants in this instance feels slightly maladapted.
items.stem: According to the last paragraph, the real worry arising from this deal is ______ .
choices: the vicious rivalry among big pharmas
the ineffective enforcement of privacy law
the uncontrolled use of new software
the monopoly of big data by tech giants
items.zh: 这种做法并未触及真正令人担忧的问题。真正重要的是，这些算法将归属于一家利用公共资源开发出它们的私人垄断企业。

items.text: Because representative government presupposes an informed citizenry, the report supports full literacy; stresses the study of history and government, particularly American history and American government; and encourages the use of new digital technologies.
items.stem: According to Paragraph 3, the report suggests
choices: an exclusive study of American history.
a greater emphasis on theoretical subjects.
the application of emerging technologies.
funding for the study of foreign languages.
items.zh: 由于代议制政府以了解情况的公民群体为前提，报告支持完全的读写能力，强调研究历史和政治学（尤其是美国历史和美国政治），并鼓励使用新的数字技术。

items.text: But exploring one's smartphone is more like entering his or her home. A smartphone may contain an arrestee's reading history, financial history, medical history and comprehensive records of recent correspondence.
items.stem: The author believes that exploring one’s phone contents is comparable to
choices: going through one’s wallet.
handling one’s historical records.
scanning one’s correspondences.
getting into one’s residence.
items.zh: 但查看某人的智能手机更像是进入他或她的家。一部智能手机可能包含被捕者的阅读记录、财务记录、医疗记录以及近期通信的全面记录。

items.text: Their thinking often had a traditional superstitious quality.
items.ctx: While few craftsmen or farmers, let alone dependents and servants, left literary compositions to be analyzed, it is obvious that their views were less fully intellectualized.
items.stem: The story of John Dane shows that less well-educated New Englanders were  often
choices: influenced by superstitions.
troubled with religious beliefs.
puzzled by church sermons.
frustrated with family earnings.
items.zh: 他们的思维常常带有一种传统的迷信色彩。

items.text: As technology advances and a format becomes obsolete, the object is useless. Have you ever stared helplessly at a ZIP disk, thinking: how do I get the files off this?
items.stem: The “ZIP disk” is cited as an example to show .
choices: the difficulty of retrieving files through unusual means
the infeasibility of constantly migrating digital assets
the possibility of losing information in obsolete formats
the inconvenience of storing information on analog devices
items.zh: 随着技术的进步、某种格式逐渐过时，该对象便变得毫无用处。你是否曾无助地盯着一张ZIP磁盘，心里想着：我究竟怎样才能把里面的文件取出来呢？

items.text: But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France.
items.ctx: The digital services tax now awaits the signature of President Emmanuel Macron, who has expressed support for the measure, and it could go into effect within the next few weeks.
items.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 2 that the digital services tax ______ .
choices: may trigger countermeasures against France
is apt to arouse criticism at home and abroad
aims to ease international trade tensions
will prompt the tech giants to quit France
items.zh: 但它已经引发了重大争议，美国贸易代表已就该税是否歧视美国公司展开调查，而这反过来可能导致针对法国的贸易制裁。

items.text: The main purpose of this "clawback" rule is to hold bankers accountable for harmful risk-taking and to restore public trust in financial institutions. Yet officials also hope for a much larger benefit: more long-term decision-making, not only by banks but by all corporations, to build a stronger economy for future generations.
items.stem: According to Paragraph 1, one motive in imposing the new rule is to ______ .
choices: enhance bankers' sense of responsibility
help corporations achieve larger profits
build a new system of financial regulation
guarantee the bonuses of top executives
items.zh: 这项“追回”（clawback）规定的主要目的，是让银行家为有害的冒险行为负责，并恢复公众对金融机构的信任。然而官员们还期望获得一个大得多的好处：更多的长期决策——不仅出自银行，而且出自所有公司——从而为子孙后代建立起更强大的经济。

items.text: But these open-source programs are built by scraping images from the Internet, often without permission and proper attribution to artists. As a result, they are raising tricky questions about ethics and copyright.
items.stem: The problem with open-source AI art generators is that they
choices: lack flexibility in responding to prompts
produce artworks in unpredictable styles
make unauthorized use of online images
collect user information without consent
items.zh: 但这些开源程序是通过从互联网上抓取图像构建起来的，而且往往未经许可、也未对艺术家进行恰当署名。因此，它们正引发关于伦理与版权的棘手问题。

items.text: New, disruptive technology sometimes demands novel applications of the Constitution's protections. Orin Kerr, a law professor, compares the explosion and accessibility of digital information in the 21st century with the establishment of automobile use as a virtual necessity of life in the 20th: The justices had to specify novel rules for the new personal domain of the passenger car then; they must sort out how the Fourth Amendment applies to digital information now.
items.stem: Orin Kerr’s comparison is quoted to indicate that
choices: the Constitution should be implemented flexibly.
principles of the Constitution should never be altered.
California’s argument violates principles of the Constitution.
new technology requires reinterpretation of the Constitution.
items.zh: 新的、颠覆性的技术有时要求对宪法的保护作出新的运用。法学教授奥林·克尔把21世纪数字信息的爆炸式增长与可获取性，比作20世纪将汽车使用确立为一种实际生活必需：当年大法官们必须为乘用车这一新的私人领域制定新规则；如今他们则必须厘清第四修正案如何适用于数字信息。

items.text: How can the train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares? This year's rise, an average of 2.7 per cent, may be a fraction lower than last year's, but it is still well above the official Consumer Price Index (CPI) measure of inflation.
items.stem: The author holds that this year's increase in rail passengers fares ______ .
choices: will ease train operation's burden
has kept pace with inflation
is a big surprise to commuters
remains an unreasonable measure
items.zh: 铁路运营商究竟怎么能为又一次上调铁路乘客票价辩解呢？今年的涨幅平均为2.7%，或许比去年略低一点，但仍远高于官方消费者价格指数（CPI）所衡量的通胀水平。
